title: FEAT: A Preference Feedback Dataset through a Cost-Effective Auto-Generation and Labeling Framework for English AI Tutoring
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈数据审计
one_line: FEAT releases tutoring prompts with candidate instructional answers, textual feedback, and human ranking signals for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
FEAT 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。
why: The release supports feedback learning for 英语辅导中的教师反馈质量.
inclusion_reason: Public preference, reward, or feedback data with a documented comparison contract and official release link.

title: Problem
问题
html:
English AI tutors need feedback that explains how to improve a student-facing response, yet teacher feedback is expensive to collect at scale. FEAT studies the trade-off between feedback quality and collection cost. Its boundary is pedagogical feedback for English tutoring, not a universal ranking of answers or a proof that a response teaches every learner effectively.

The relevant object is a tutoring context, candidate instructional feedback, and a preference or quality signal about that feedback. The paper asks how generated and human-assisted feedback can be combined without discarding the explanatory content that makes a preference useful for tutoring. It does not equate a preferred feedback sentence with validated learning gain in a classroom.

英语人工智能辅导需要能说明如何改进的教师反馈，但大规模收集此类反馈成本很高。FEAT 讨论反馈质量与收集成本之间的取舍。其边界是英语辅导中的教学反馈，不是对所有回答作普适排序，也不是证明某段反馈会让每位学习者都获得同等学习效果。

相关对象是辅导语境、候选教学反馈，以及针对这些反馈的偏好或质量信号。论文关注如何组合生成反馈与人机协作反馈，同时保留使偏好对教学有意义的解释内容；它没有把被偏好的反馈句子等同于已经验证的课堂学习收益。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FEAT contributes three complementary English tutoring-feedback datasets. DIRECT-Manual (DM) is generated collaboratively by humans and LLMs and is presented as higher quality but more costly. DIRECT-Generated (DG) is LLM-only and lower cost but lower quality. DIRECT-Augmented (DA) starts from DG and adds a small portion of DM to improve quality while retaining cost efficiency.

The feedback contract is not a bare answer winner: feedback explains why an instructional response is preferable. This makes the data useful for preference learning and reward modeling aimed at pedagogical quality. The three resources also expose a collection-source distinction that must remain visible; DM, DG, and DA are not interchangeable labels with identical provenance.

FEAT 提供三套互补的英语辅导反馈数据。DIRECT-Manual（DM）由人类与语言模型协作生成，论文将其描述为质量较高但成本较高；DIRECT-Generated（DG）仅由语言模型生成，成本较低但质量较低；DIRECT-Augmented（DA）以 DG 为主体，加入少量 DM，以兼顾质量和成本。

反馈契约不是只选出一个胜者：反馈还解释为何某个教学回答更可取。因此数据可用于面向教学质量的偏好学习和奖励建模。三套资源同时暴露了收集来源差异；DM、DG 和 DA 的谱系不同，不能被当作完全等价的标签。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Construct DIRECT-Manual through collaboration between humans and LLMs to obtain higher-quality teacher feedback. 2. Construct DIRECT-Generated using LLMs only as a lower-cost source. 3. Form DIRECT-Augmented mainly from DG and add a small DM portion. 4. Train or evaluate tutoring feedback with these alternatives and compare their cost-quality trade-off.

The reported experiment tests adding 5–10% DM to DG rather than using only one source. Reproduction requires the tutoring prompts, feedback-generation prompts and models, human contribution protocol, selection rule for the DM portion, dataset revision, and evaluation setting. Replacing any of these choices can change both the feedback distribution and the claimed cost-quality trade-off.

1. 通过人类与语言模型协作构建 DIRECT-Manual，以获得较高质量的教师反馈。2. 仅用语言模型构建 DIRECT-Generated，作为较低成本来源。3. 以 DG 为主体并加入少量 DM，形成 DIRECT-Augmented。4. 用三种来源训练或评测辅导反馈，并比较质量与成本的取舍。

论文报告的实验测试了在 DG 中加入 5%–10% 的 DM，而非只使用一种来源。复现须固定辅导提示、反馈生成提示和模型、人类参与协议、DM 样本选择规则、数据版本和评测设定；任何一项改变都可能改变反馈分布和所声称的成本质量关系。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that adding a small 5–10% portion of DIRECT-Manual to DIRECT-Generated yields better performance than using 100% DIRECT-Manual alone. This is the key experimental evidence for the proposed cost-effective mixture. It supports the authors’ English-tutoring tasks, generation procedures, and evaluation configuration, not a general law that small human mixtures always dominate fully human data.

The three named datasets are also direct evidence of differing provenance: DM is human–LLM collaborative, DG is LLM-only, and DA mixes DG with DM. The paper’s abstract does not disclose every dataset size, annotator detail, or classroom outcome, so those facts should be marked unverified unless checked in the paper or release.

论文报告，在 DIRECT-Generated 中加入少量 5%–10% 的 DIRECT-Manual，优于只使用 100% DIRECT-Manual。这是支撑成本有效混合方案的关键实验。它只支持作者的英语辅导任务、生成过程和评测配置，不能推出“小比例人工混合总会优于全人工数据”的普遍规律。

三套命名数据本身也提供来源差异证据：DM 为人机协作，DG 为仅语言模型生成，DA 为 DG 与 DM 的混合。摘要没有披露全部数据规模、标注细节或课堂学习结果；未回到论文或发布材料核验的事实必须保持待核验状态。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest contrast is collecting expensive human teacher feedback or using low-cost synthetic feedback as a single source. FEAT makes the collection mixture itself a controlled data object: DM, DG, and DA differ by provenance, and DA explicitly injects 5–10% DM into DG. The resulting direction signal is that a small higher-quality feedback slice can be studied as part of a scalable tutoring-feedback recipe.

The work does not introduce a universal teaching verifier or establish that generated feedback substitutes for teachers. Its novelty is the released comparative feedback construction and its cost-quality experiment, not the mere use of LLMs to write tutoring text.

最接近的对照是昂贵的人工教师反馈，或单独使用低成本合成反馈。FEAT 把数据来源混合作为受控对象：DM、DG 和 DA 的谱系不同，而 DA 明确在 DG 中注入 5%–10% 的 DM。其方向信号是可将少量较高质量反馈作为可扩展辅导反馈方案的一部分进行研究。

该工作没有提出普适教学验证器，也没有证明生成反馈能够替代教师。新意在于公开的对比反馈构建及其成本质量实验，而不是仅仅让语言模型生成辅导文本。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
DM, DG, and DA can differ in more than cost: they may encode different model styles, human editing practices, and tutoring assumptions. A mixture result can therefore reflect source artifacts rather than a generally better pedagogical signal. Audit examples by learner level and error type, and compare explanatory feedback with whether it is actually correct and actionable.

The evidence is limited to the reported English tutoring setting. Check permissions and provenance for prompt and feedback sources, and do not transfer a preferred feedback style to other languages, age groups, or high-stakes educational decisions without separate evaluation. The paper does not establish long-term learning outcomes.

DM、DG 和 DA 的差异不只在成本，也可能包含模型风格、人类编辑习惯和辅导假设。混合结果因此可能反映来源痕迹，而非普遍更好的教学信号。应按学习者水平和错误类型审计样例，并检查解释性反馈是否正确且可执行。

证据限于论文报告的英语辅导环境。应核对提示和反馈来源的许可与谱系；未经单独评测，不能把被偏好的反馈风格迁移到其他语言、年龄群体或高风险教育决策。论文并未建立长期学习结果。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use FEAT to compare feedback-generation sources for English tutoring, train a feedback preference model, or audit the cost-quality effect of mixing data. Preserve the DM/DG/DA source label and explanatory feedback rather than combining all examples into one undifferentiated pool. Evaluate by learner task and error type, and verify whether a model’s preferred feedback is correct, specific, and actionable.

For reuse, reproduce the 5–10% DM mixture against DG and 100% DM under a fixed budget. The resource is not appropriate as a sole basis for grading, individualized education plans, or claims about learning improvement, because the paper evaluates feedback quality rather than long-term student outcomes.

可用 FEAT 比较英语辅导的反馈生成来源、训练反馈偏好模型，或审计混合数据的成本质量效应。应保留 DM/DG/DA 来源标签和解释性反馈，不能把所有样例混为无差别语料。评测应按学习任务和错误类型展开，并核验模型偏好的反馈是否正确、具体且可执行。

复用时，应在固定预算下重现 5%–10% DM 与 DG、100% DM 的比较。该资源不适合作为评分、个别化教育计划或学习提升主张的唯一依据，因为论文评测的是反馈质量，而非学生的长期学习结果。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Identify which examples are DM, DG, and DA. 2. Read the human–LLM collaboration protocol before treating DM as a human-only label. 3. Reproduce the 5–10% DM mixture with a fixed budget. 4. Inspect whether feedback explains an error and supplies an actionable next step. 5. Separate feedback-quality evaluation from evidence of student learning.

The audit question is whether DA improves tutoring feedback because of its small DM content or because of an uncontrolled source difference. Record provenance and cost alongside quality metrics so the result remains interpretable.

1. 识别样例属于 DM、DG 还是 DA。2. 在把 DM 当作纯人工标签前，阅读人机协作协议。3. 在固定预算下重现 5%–10% DM 的混合。4. 检查反馈是否解释错误并提供可执行的下一步。5. 将反馈质量评测与学生学习证据分开。

审计问题是：DA 的提升来自少量 DM，还是来自未控制的来源差异。应把谱系和成本与质量指标一起记录，使结果保持可解释。
